festivals.name: New Life Festival
festivals.purpose: Marks the return of the sun on the 1st of Morning Star with free spiced mead, lantern braziers, and ice-plunge dares in Windhelm's courtyard.

festivals.name: South Winds' Prayer
festivals.purpose: Kynareth's mid-winter blessing beneath the Gildergreen asking for mild winds and an early thaw for the tundra farms.

festivals.name: Heart's Day
festivals.purpose: Temple of Mara's feast of courtship and betrothals across Riften's canal bridges, with sweetrolls, amulets of Mara, and love ballads.

festivals.name: First Planting
festivals.purpose: Spring sowing festival in the western tundra breadbasket celebrating fresh soil, shared seed-grain, and peace with neighbors.

festivals.name: Ice-Break Harbour Fair
festivals.purpose: Celebrates the spring breakup of Sea of Ghosts pack ice, when Dawnstar's longships and whalers clear the harbour channel.

festivals.name: Jester's Day
festivals.purpose: Street theatre, harmless pranks, and satirical ballads led by Bards College students along Solitude's cobbled avenue.

festivals.name: Second Planting & Pine Blessing
festivals.purpose: Late-spring planting and floral wreath laying in Falkreath, honouring Arkay's cycle of life and renewal after winter.

festivals.name: Mid Year Fen-Warding
festivals.purpose: Midsummer boardwalk vigil in Morthal where townsfolk hang alchemical ward-lanterns to keep swamp vapours and night terrors at bay.

festivals.name: Burning of King Olaf
festivals.purpose: Solitude's signature Bards College festival: reciting the Verse of King Olaf, burning his straw effigy, and distributing free spiced wine.

festivals.name: Merchants' Festival
festivals.purpose: Grand open-air market fair at Whiterun's central crossroads where hold merchants and Khajiit caravanners offer special wares.

festivals.name: Silver Assize & Dibellan Fair
festivals.purpose: Annual weighing of Reach silver ingots and Dibellan arts exhibition across Markarth's Dwemer stone tiers.

festivals.name: Harvest's End
festivals.purpose: Celebration of the year's harvest and autumn mead casks in Riften beneath the golden birch canopy, with free mead and fish feasts.

festivals.name: Tales and Tallows
festivals.purpose: Candlelit night of ancestor stories and Arkay vigils in Falkreath to honour the honoured dead and ward the barrows.

festivals.name: Aurora Convocation
festivals.purpose: Open symposium hosted by the College of Winterhold under the autumn aurora, trading scrolls, soul gems, and warm snowberry tea.

festivals.name: Witches' Festival
festivals.purpose: Frostfall gathering where alchemists, hedge-mages, and monster hunters trade ward-brews and take bounties against covens and undead.

festivals.name: Warriors' Festival
festivals.purpose: Armourers' and veterans' festival in Windhelm honouring Ysgramor's Five Hundred Companions with weapon displays and bounty hunts.

festivals.name: Saturalia & Old Life Vigil
festivals.purpose: Year-end gift exchange and Old Life lantern vigil along the northern coast before the New Life sunrise.

festivals.name: Mad Pelagius's Day & Bluff-Charter Fair
festivals.purpose: Daggerfall's mid-winter masquerade and harbour-chain inspection where burghers mock old baronial pomposity while the Knights of the Dragon parade.

festivals.name: Mara's Plough-Blessing & Birch-Truce
festivals.purpose: Spring blessing of the plough-shares in Alcaire's square, while parish tenants quietly hang white birch-charms on the forest boundary.

festivals.name: Kambria Assize & Dibellan Brush-Fair
festivals.purpose: Spring flower-and-linen fair in Kambria where Dibella's cantors mediate debt-redemptions and old soldiers trade carved karst-stone keepsakes.

festivals.name: Iliac Bay Regatta & Rose-Lists
festivals.purpose: Grand maritime regatta across the Bjoulsae mouth and tournament of the Knights of the Rose, where guild-barques race under silk pennons.

festivals.name: Day of the High Anvil & Blood-Price Truce
festivals.purpose: Autumn gathering at Merchant's Gate and Orsinium where stronghold chiefs and city smiths weigh the year's orichalcum ingots under sacred truce.

festivals.name: Hound-Bell Vigil & Wyrd-Root Fair
festivals.purpose: Frostfall lantern-watch in Camlorn and Eagles Brook where silver-smiths and Wyrd-sisters renew the cairn-wards against the moor-packs.

festivals.name: Night of the Second Lamp
festivals.purpose: Solemn vigil in Shornhelm and Northpoint when every window sets out a second oil-lamp for Arkay and the cliff-beacons are blessed with salt.

festivals.name: Abbey Turnpike Jubilee
festivals.purpose: Midsummer hospital-fair in Shalgora and Urvaius where abbey stewards suspend turnpike tolls and bless pilgrim companies.

festivals.name: Evermor River-Lock & Horse-Clan Fair
festivals.purpose: Annual horse-trial and wool-barge rendezvous at Evermor where river-men and upland riders renew the Oath of the Stirrup.

festivals.name: Festival of Blades & Candle-Vigil
festivals.purpose: Sentinel's celebrated exhibition of Ansei sword-forms on the palace terraces, followed at dusk by the lighting of ten thousand brass lamps at Tu'whacca's Throne.

festivals.name: Renewal of the Well-Oaths & Leki's Trial
festivals.purpose: Sacred desert truce in Skaven and Bergama when nomad matrons and Crown oasis-lords drink from the same brass bowl to renew the water-laws.

festivals.name: Z'en's Timber-Scale & Pass-Watch Fair
festivals.purpose: Harvest and timber-tally fair in Lainlyn and Ayasofya where Breton millwrights and Redguard garrison families feast under Z'en's balanced scale.

festivals.name: Day of the Open Crucible
festivals.purpose: Annual banking of the Dragontail smelters in Rihad and Tigonus when indentured miners are granted holiday rations and Arkay's priests bless the shafts.

festivals.name: Warrior's Zenith & Elinhir Star-Fair
festivals.purpose: Equinox convocation in Elinhir and Belkarth when astromancers open the Nede star-terraces and Dragonstar champions hold exhibition bouts.

festivals.name: Night of the Unbarred Gate & Lantern-Tide
festivals.purpose: Solemn seawall vigil in Taneth and Abah's Landing honouring the defenders of the Great War while paper lanterns are set adrift on the bay.

festivals.name: Second Treaty Regatta & Hunding's Day
festivals.purpose: Island-wide celebration in Port Hunding marking the signing of the Second Treaty of Stros M'Kai with cutter races, Dwemer brass-work displays, and harbour feasts.

festivals.name: Pale Pass Thaw & Talos Torch-Muster
festivals.purpose: Spring opening of the Pale Pass snow-gates in Bruma, celebrated with Nord-Imperial torch processions, spiced mead casks, and customs-truce feasts.

festivals.name: Great Oak Assize & Highland Fleece Fair
festivals.purpose: Annual shearing-tally and open-air court beneath Chorrol's Great Oak, where highland shepherds, loggers, and Fighters Guild champions feast together.

festivals.name: Imperial City Arena Grand Championship & Ruby Jubilee
festivals.purpose: Midsummer title bouts in the Imperial City Arena paired with open-air markets across the six wards and lantern barges on Lake Rumare.

festivals.name: Great Forest Wayshrine Vigil & Woodland Fair
festivals.purpose: Midsummer lantern-blessing at Weye and Wawnet Inn where foresters, pilgrims, and Arcane University scholars ward the woodland trails.

festivals.name: Corbolo Painted-Bridge & Willow Lantern Regatta
festivals.purpose: Spring canal festival in Cheydinhal where Dunmer and Nibenese families float painted paper lanterns beneath the willow bridges and auction the first silk bales.

festivals.name: Skingrad Colovian Wine Harvest & First Cask Tapping
festivals.purpose: Skingrad's famous autumn vintage festival when the Surilie and Tamika presses tap the first casks in the cobbled courtyard and crown the Harvest Cooper.

festivals.name: Anvil Golden Sail & Dibellan Lighthouse Fair
festivals.purpose: Late-summer maritime fair on Anvil's quays where Dibella's priestesses bless the great lighthouse flame and masonry guilds raise funds for Kvatch.

festivals.name: Gala of the Lucky Old Lady & Niben Barge-Moot
festivals.purpose: Autumn river-moot in Bravil when barge-captains toss copper wish-coins into the Lucky Old Lady's basin and the Chapel of Mara distributes warm soup along the canals.

festivals.name: Topal Bay Reed-Lantern Vigil & Zenithar Scale-Day
festivals.purpose: Year-end tide-watch in Leyawiin where Imperial merchants, Argonian reed-weavers, and Khajiit traders balance their ledgers at Zenithar's chapel and float reed-lamps down the Niben mouth.

festivals.name: Inner Sea Charter-Moot & Ebonheart Regatta
festivals.purpose: Spring opening of the Inner Sea shipping lanes at Ebonheart, where Imperial legates and Great House councillors feast on the harbour terrace and bless the packet-fleets.

festivals.name: Procession of Mother Morrowind's Mercy
festivals.purpose: Sacred spring feast across Godsreach and the Great Bazaar of Mournhold celebrating Lady Almalexia's healing charity with alms-tables, brass censers, and open-air plays.

festivals.name: Vigil of the White Walls & Ancestor-Lantern Night
festivals.purpose: Solemn autumn pilgrimage in Necrom when thousands of white paper lanterns are hung along the ossuary terraces to honor the ancestors of all Dunmer clans.

festivals.name: Sadrith Mora Spore-Bloom & Magisterial Fair
festivals.purpose: Midsummer spore-release beneath Tel Naga in Sadrith Mora, when Mouths auction rare alchemical salts, Telvanni bug-musk, and enchanted trinkets around the Gateway Inn.

festivals.name: Dagon Fel Whale-Boat Return & Sanctus Vigil
festivals.purpose: Late-summer harbour feast at Dagon Fel where Nord whalers and Dunmer islanders light the northern watchtower brazier and share roasted horker and mazte.

festivals.name: Muster of Skar & Ashlander Gate-Truce
festivals.purpose: Autumn martial muster in Ald'ruhn when Redoran retainers parade in polished bonemold outside Skar and Ashlander traders open the seasonal hide-market at the western gate.

festivals.name: Vos Golden Wickwheat Harvest & Herd-Compact
festivals.purpose: Harvest fair on the golden savannah at Vos where Tel Vos farmers and Zainab herders trade fresh wickwheat sheaves, guar-milk cheeses, and hackle-lo leaf.

festivals.name: Twilight Vigil of Azura's Coast
festivals.purpose: Dusk-to-dawn lantern vigil at Molag Mar and along the eastern headlands celebrating the Star of the Courtyard and blessing pilgrims bound for Mount Assarnibibi.

festivals.name: Balmora Odai Barge-Fair & Hlaalu Assay Day
festivals.purpose: Midsummer trade jubilee along the bridges of the Odai River in Balmora, when Hlaalu factors, Caldera miners, and guild halls open their courtyard stalls and tap casks of flin.

festivals.name: Gnaar Mok Netch-Lantern Tide & Fisher's Truce
festivals.purpose: Autumn night-festival on the boardwalks of Gnaar Mok where net-fishers hang amber netch-bladder lanterns over the marsh channels to guide boats safely home.

festivals.name: Jubilee of the Seven Graces & Canton Regatta
festivals.purpose: Grand lagoon festival across the cantons of Vivec City celebrating Lord Vivec's victory and the Seven Graces with decorated gondolas, Temple choir hymns, and open alms-tables.

festivals.name: Vigil of the Two Towers & Ancestor-Pylon Renewal
festivals.purpose: Solemn martial vigil at Ghostgate when Buoyant Armigers and Ordinators consecrate the Ghostfence bone-pylons with blue soul-braziers and honor those who stand watch against the Blight.

festivals.name: Raven Rock Bulwark-Watch & All-Maker Hearth-Truce
festivals.purpose: Winter solstice gathering at Raven Rock where Redoran guards, Tel Mithryn retainers, and visiting Skaal hunters light the great ash-bulwark braziers and tap casks of Shein and Thirsk mead.

festivals.name: Day of the Sundered Shackle & Percolating Mire Fair
festivals.purpose: Annual remembrance in Thorn and across Shadowfen where Chain-Breaker clans strike rusted slaver irons upon the shackle-cairns and share spiced bog-eel and reed-woven charms.

festivals.name: Shadow-Sign Natal Vigil & Border-Ring Truce
festivals.purpose: Spring convocation in Stormhold where Tree-Minders, Shadowscale elders, and border caravan factors bless the hatching-pools beneath the Shadow constellation.

festivals.name: Great Hist Sap-Naming & Root-Heart Communion
festivals.purpose: Sacred midsummer communion around the ancient Hist of Helstrom where young Saxhleel receive their true Jel names and outer-ring delegates bring offerings of amber resin.

festivals.name: Gideon Levee-Rice Harvest & Two-Shrine Assize
festivals.purpose: Late-summer harvest fair along the walled levees of Gideon where Lukiul townsfolk and marsh punt-men weigh the first bog-rice sheaves and feast between the chapel and root-shrine.

festivals.name: Lilmoth Silver-Bell Tide & Quay Truce
festivals.purpose: Autumn harbour festival on the wharves of Lilmoth honouring the Kothringi quarantine-shrines with floating silver lanterns and open spice-barge auctions.

festivals.name: Xanmeer Calendar-Turn & Sithis Renewal Feast
festivals.purpose: Late-autumn festival at the stilt-plazas and stepped Xanmeer terraces of Murkmire celebrating Sithis's cycle of change with bone-flute dances and canoe regattas.

festivals.name: Riverhold Well-Compact & Two-Moons Caravan Moot
festivals.purpose: Spring caravan moot in Riverhold where northern well-clans, Baandari pedlars, and moonstone cutters seal the dry-season cistern shares and race desert mounts.

festivals.name: Rimmen Night of Painted Masks & Aqueduct Fair
festivals.purpose: Equinox festival beneath Rimmen's great aqueduct arches where Hakoshae mask-makers and alabaster carvers honour the ancestors with gilded masks and sugar-spice stalls.

festivals.name: Torval Two-Moons Alignment & Cedar Sanctum Jubilee
festivals.purpose: Grand pilgrimage jubilee in Torval when Jone and Jode stand high above the Mane's palanquin court and temple bells ring from every cedar terrace.

festivals.name: Corinthe First-Boil Sugar Harvest & Garden Blessing
festivals.purpose: Late-summer cane harvest in Corinthe when Pellitine's boil-houses tap the first golden syrup vats and garden-priests bless the cutters with holiday rations.

festivals.name: Senchal Khenarthi Wind-Blessing & Gilded Regatta
festivals.purpose: Harbour festival across Senchal's Palace Hill and Lower Sweet wards celebrating Khenarthi's monsoon trade-winds with silk-sailed dhows and spice-wharf banquets.

festivals.name: Silvenar & Green Lady's Bough-Union Feast
festivals.purpose: Spring festival in the canopy halls of Silvenar celebrating the living bond of the Silvenar and the Green Lady with bone-bow contests and casks of fermented jagga.

festivals.name: Arenthia Bone-Truce & Moonmont Harvest Moot
festivals.purpose: Autumn border-moot in Arenthia and Rawl'kha where Bosmer treethanes and Khajiit clan-elders renew the Bone-Truce rite and trade savanna grain for cured hides.

festivals.name: Elden Root Crown-Lamp & Sap-Offering Jubilee
festivals.purpose: Midsummer convocation in the colossal boughs of Elden Root when Spinners and sap-tappers hang luminous amber gourd-lamps from the upper walkways.

festivals.name: Woodhearth Wilder-Song & Spinner's Tide
festivals.purpose: Spring festival across the root-bridges of Woodhearth where Spinners of Greenshade sing the forest's waking verses and coastal fishers roast the first net-catch.

festivals.name: Alinor Festival of Eightfold Refraction & Ancestor Lamps
festivals.purpose: High summer convocation in Alinor when Sapiarchs align prism-lenses along the alabaster terraces and noble houses light crystal ancestor-lamps at dusk.

festivals.name: Firsthold Blossom-Tide & Auri-El's Ascent
festivals.purpose: Spring festival in Firsthold and Skywatch celebrating Auri-El's Ascent beneath falling cherry blossoms with harp recitals, marine honour-drills, and orchard feasts.

festivals.name: Artaeum Conclave of the Old Ways & Syrabane's Vigil
festivals.purpose: Serene autumn vigil around the Ceporah orchards and Grand Psijic Villa on Artaeum honouring the Ancestor-Counsel of the Old Ways and Syrabane's ring.

festivals.name: Kjolvik Summer-Lead Break & Whale-Totem Hearth
festivals.purpose: Brief midsummer celebration at Kjolvik Anchorage when the pack-ice leads crack open for Windhelm charter ships and crews light drift-pine bonfires before the Whale Totem.

festivals.name: Jylkurfyk Keel-Remembrance & Rime-Barrow Watch
festivals.purpose: Expedition vigil among the petrified shipyards of Jylkurfyk where Nord chroniclers and delvers toast the Five Hundred and ward the frost-bound barrows.

festivals.name: Day of the Crimson Lacquer Seal & Canal Truce
festivals.purpose: Ceremonial spring tally-opening at the Black Lacquer Pagoda where Tsaesci seal-custodians permit charter factors to trade silk and folded steel under strict court protocol.

festivals.name: Ada'Soom's Gate Thaw-Watch & Iron-Brazier Muster
festivals.purpose: Late-winter martial muster at Ada'Soom's Gate where garrison wardens bank the great steam-ice braziers and prepare the pass barricades before the spring thaw.

festivals.name: Tang Mo Cloud-Bamboo & Strait Lantern Festival
festivals.purpose: Joyful island festival in Tang Mo Harbor Village where monkey-folk rangers and charter sailors hang woven bamboo lanterns across the suspension bridges.

festivals.name: Tosh Raka's Golden Steppe & Dragon-Bell Zenith
festivals.purpose: High-sun convocation before Tosh Raka's Palace and Tiger Plains Village where Tiger-Monk retainers ring the bronze dragon-bells and hold martial trials of strength.

festivals.name: Vigil of the Warrior Constellation & Ansei Memory
festivals.purpose: Star-clear autumn vigil at the Hall of the Ansei where Ankh-keepers and Redguard pilgrims recite the Book of Circles beneath the risen Warrior constellation.

festivals.name: Equinox Low-Tide Salvage & Drowned Kings' Vigil
festivals.purpose: Equinox low-tide gathering on the Isle of the Drowned Ansei when the sunken causeways emerge above the surf and divers lay copper lamps upon the wave-worn shrines.

festivals.name: Tide of the Coiled King & Black Pearl Truce-Fair
festivals.purpose: Mist-shrouded maritime fair at the Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage where Storm-Caste chanters honour Immortal Orgnum and truce-captains open the black-pearl chests.

festivals.name: Night of the Phosphor-Tide & Sandbar Exchange
festivals.purpose: Bioluminescent winter neap-tide around the Coral Tower of Thras and the quarantined sandbars when alchemical brokers trade rare abyssal reagents by strict weight.
